heading: INT. HOLLOWED ASTEROID ORCHARD - SHIFT NIGHT

units.text: INT. HOLLOWED ASTEROID ORCHARD - SHIFT NIGHT
A cavern of rock lit by amber grow-lamps.
Rows of dwarf apple trees bolted to drifting soil trays.
TAVITA (50s, broad, vacuum-scarred hands) stands at a control stump.
NELL (20s, sharp, ink-stained fingers) clutches a tablet.
ISAAK (60s, wiry, one cloudy eye) leans on a ladder.
MEI-LIN (30s, braided cables in her hair) hovers upside down.
OSEI (teen, oversized pressure jacket) grips a pruning rod.
Hull pressure's dropping in the north orchard. Everyone stays calm.
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: Calm is a luxury. The seal's gone, Tavita. I can hear it.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Then shut the bulkhead. Trees can bloom again.
units.name: ISAAK

units.text: Not if we're on the wrong side of it. Osei's still holding row nine.
units.name: MEI-LIN

units.text: I can let go. I can run.
units.name: OSEI

units.text: You'll run when I say run.
units.name: TAVITA

units.text: Forty seconds of air at that leak rate. Maybe thirty.
units.name: NELL

units.text: Then thirty is what we use. Mei-Lin, drones to the breach. Nell, patch kit. Osei, row nine, now.
units.name: ISAAK

units.text: Drones are going. They won't hold it.
units.name: MEI-LIN

units.text: They don't have to hold it. They only have to buy us the walk.
units.name: TAVITA
